source.title: More Bat Eyes
source.objective:
Progress<name>, the attraction I'm designing will be the scariest event since Gnomeregan was overrun!  And it's largely thanks to you and all the baubles you've brought me.  Many, many thanks!

I don't need much else, but... if you bring me more evil bat eyes from the bats of the Eastern Plaguelands... I might have more Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
source.completion: Thanks again, <name>.  Here are your tickets!
